provenance.description: Owner-authorized fictional Act 2 reassignment and retained productivity lesson, followed by committed December demand and Southern Hemisphere summer holiday protection. Not an observed maintenance-deferral outcome.

assumptions: The December demand uplift, staffing availability and productivity model are new follow-on scenario inputs, not observations in the August dataset.
The 21-day rule covers changes to existing published shifts and line assignments; a separate policy permits qualified temporary staff on unchanged shifts.
The staffing ceiling conservatively uses the shared dataset's planned daily output. The model does not authorize exceeding the shared production envelope.

The owner selected the colleague's staffing narrative: the earlier fictional decision reassigned workers and retained the staffing productivity lesson. This versioned narrative is not evidence of the original maintenance-deferral execution and does not overwrite its record.

The owner's latest speaker notes retain December and Southern Hemisphere summer holidays, superseding the colleague brief's nine-month interval. The notice period is a current SQL policy, not a learned rule in Cosmos DB.

case.title: Hydration Sunscreen: Southern Hemisphere summer staffing review

policies.title: Published shift protection
policies.body: Existing employees require 21 days of notice before published shift or line-assignment changes. Qualified temporary assignments on unchanged shifts are evaluated under the separate temporary staffing policy.

policies.title: Qualified temporary packing assignments
policies.body: Qualified temporary packers may join unchanged shifts when availability and onboarding are confirmed before production. Staffing must stay inside the line-specific model and production ceiling. Operations and HR must approve the same current plan.

rehearsalMemory.author: Karin Blair
rehearsalMemory.lesson: End-of-line throughput was people-bound. Additional qualified packers increased daily output according to the line staffing model, within the production ceiling.
rehearsalMemory.priorAction: Existing qualified workers were reassigned between lines to support the proposed campaign.
rehearsalMemory.workforcePriority: Protect colleagues' holiday plans and give people advance notice of changes to their published shifts.
